summary: Onyx Community Edition provides a chat interface designed to connect with various large language models. It includes built-in tools such as web search, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and connectors for numerous knowledge sources.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a feature-rich, unified chat front-end to interface with multiple external or local language models under an MIT licence.
watchOut: Integrating numerous knowledge connectors and running advanced agentic workflows can introduce significant configuration overhead and high resource consumption.
deployNotes: Deployment typically relies on container orchestration via Docker or Kubernetes, which usually requires provisioning persistent volumes for state and configuring a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
